phase_class: fresh third-law transfer test; known synthetic PDE; no confirmatory claim beyond the frozen gate
hypothesis: The Phase-10/11 18-bit tail-aware causal innovation representation plus the unchanged generic 16-feature context-only identifier can transfer to a qualitatively different, completely unseen two-channel dispersive nonlinear PDE family without fitting tokenizer statistics, codebooks, thresholds, or feature choices on that family.

frozen_representation_training.training_mixture: exact Phase-10/11 mixture only: 64 low-mode wave sequences plus 64 smooth Gray-Scott sequences, seq_len 8, grid 16
frozen_representation_training.state_codec: 2048+128 residual VQ on joint physical state, fit only on wave+Gray-Scott training mixture
frozen_representation_training.innovation_statistics: mean/std from raw one-step wave+Gray-Scott training-mixture differences only
frozen_representation_training.plain_innovation_control: 2048+128 residual VQ fit only on wave+Gray-Scott training-mixture innovations
frozen_representation_training.primary_codec: frozen Phase-10/11 compander: z=(d-mu)/sigma; y=asinh(z); clip corresponding to z in [-16,+16]; two independent 512-level y quantizers packed into exactly 18 bits

frozen_identifier.features: unchanged Phase-7/9/10/11 basis: constant; per channel center, D4 axial radius-1 sum, diagonal radius-1 sum, axial radius-2 sum; plus center u^2, uv, v^2, u^3, u^2v, uv^2, v^3
frozen_identifier.feature_scaling: per-sequence RMS from the two observed context transitions; constant scale fixed to 1

unseen_family.name: two-dimensional cubic nonlinear Schrodinger / Gross-Pitaevskii-like discrete-time system
discrete_update: u_next = u + dt * (-alpha * Laplacian(v) + g * (u^2+v^2) * v)
v_next = v + dt * (+alpha * Laplacian(u) - g * (u^2+v^2) * u)
unseen_family.integrator: single explicit Euler step per saved frame; chosen because the exact discrete one-step map lies inside the already-frozen generic spatial+cubic feature family
unseen_family.initialization: independent smooth periodic random real/imaginary fields generated without NLS parameter labels; each channel scaled by an independent amplitude in [0.25,0.55]

evaluations.baseline: raw-state persistence from final raw context frame
evaluations.metric: projected rollout MSE / raw-state persistence MSE

execution_rule: Each registered replicate runs exactly once in an independent process and is persisted before the next. No retry, replacement seed, NLS-informed normalization, codebook refit on NLS, feature change, ridge change, compander change, or threshold change after any registered attempt is consumed.

pass_rule.required: PASS only if the frozen companded arm has ratio < 1.0 versus raw persistence on all 4 NLS tests in all 3 fresh replicates (12/12 cells).
pass_rule.failure_policy: Any registered companded ratio >= 1.0 makes Phase 12 FAIL even if another codec wins or later replicates pass. Remaining registered replicates should still run once for characterization if infrastructure permits.

pre_execution_validation: verify Phase-10 compander LEVELS=512 and ZMAX=16.0 unchanged
verify Phase-10 feature function and fit_maps are imported unchanged
verify no NLS frames enter state/innovation statistics or VQ fitting
verify NLS generator is deterministic by seed and produces finite trajectories
verify explicit NLS one-step update is representable by the frozen feature library (Laplacian via axial sum-center combination and cubic center terms)
use only non-registered smoke seeds before registered execution
claim_limit: A PASS would show transfer of this fixed discrete representation+context-identifier recipe to one additional known synthetic PDE family absent from representation training. It would not establish a universal scientific tokenizer, unrestricted law discovery, novel physics, AGI, or SSI.
